title: Document programmatic flashlight Rerun example
objective: Update the flashlight example documentation to cover the new programmatic Rerun script, examples extra dependency install, editable compute_light_command hook, live viewport behavior, Rerun streams, and live simulator validation note.
instructions: Update examples/flashlight/README.md rather than creating a new doc unless you find that file unsuitable.
Document the command to install examples extras, including zsh-safe quoting: python -m pip install -e 'python[examples]'.
Document a concise run command for examples/flashlight/run_programmatic_rerun.py and mention --no-rerun-spawn for connecting manually.
Explain that the script follows the live viewport camera, prints camera/light status to the terminal, streams RGB/depth/world_normal/diffuse_color to Rerun, and uses diffuse_color as albedo.
Explain that programmatic light control is intended through editing compute_light_command / LightCommand in the new script.
Mention live SPEAR/Rerun end-to-end validation remains a user-run check.
constraints: Do not edit product source code.
expected_outputs: Updated README section for the new example.
ResultPacket lists docs changed and any remaining drift.
definition_of_done: README includes install, run, control-hook, Rerun streams, and validation note.
